product.name: Authentication
product.description: A user identity service for adding sign-in and account management to mobile and web applications.

product.name: Firestore
product.description: A scalable cloud-hosted NoSQL document database for storing, querying, and synchronizing application data.

product.name: Cloud Functions
product.description: A serverless platform for running backend code in response to HTTP requests, application events, and changes in Firebase or Google Cloud services.

product.name: Cloud Storage
product.description: Managed object storage for uploading and serving user-generated files such as images, video, audio, and documents.

product.name: Realtime Database
product.description: A cloud-hosted NoSQL database that synchronizes JSON data in real time across connected application clients.

product.name: App Hosting
product.description: A managed deployment service for hosting full-stack web applications with infrastructure that can scale through Google Cloud.
